title: A served line that reads more payloads than the realizer keeps (fn-arx-read-cache-entries = 8) is re-run forever under the owner: each miss discards the line, reads one entry, re-runs; cyclic LRU never warms. On 45e05c7fd at 40 articles in one group HDR/XHDR Newsgroups, XPAT Newsgroups, HDR/XHDR Xref, HDR Path, XPAT Path, HDR Organization over 1-100 and NEWNEWS fn.g1 all gave NO ANSWER in 20 s (one fresh node each). A one-client DoS of the owner
